_metadata.description: Dial-out persistent channel per node; online/offline presence + self-reported readiness; no inbound ports.

requirements.title: Dial-Out Presence & Health
requirements.description: Each node-agent maintains a persistent outbound channel to the control plane (no inbound ports on the node; NAT/firewall-proof). The control plane tracks online/offline presence and the node's self-reported readiness (toolchain present, disk headroom, container runtime up) so dispatch only targets capable nodes.

validation.notes: Presence transitions online on channel connect and offline on disconnect/heartbeat-miss; health snapshot is stored per node.
Agent establishes the channel purely outbound; no listening port is opened on the node side.
Node-agent live dial: holds the SSE stream, reports heartbeats with a health snapshot on cadence, and reconnects with backoff after a stream drop (purely outbound).
A node behind NAT/firewall stays reachable for dispatch with no inbound configuration.
